hints: Why does validating SQL syntax fail to establish authorization?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Broad production schema access.

challenges.title: Limits, clarification and audit
challenges.description: Ambiguity, row caps, statement timeout, audit and result accuracy.
challenges.problem: Test reporting rejection and timing boundaries.
requirements: Report execution accuracy and predictable denial behavior.
hints: When should the assistant ask a follow-up?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Autonomous database modification.

challenges.title: Deterministic and model-led planning
challenges.description: Explicit states, dynamic information gathering, step budgets and stopping.
challenges.problem: Compare fixed research flow with bounded decomposition.
requirements: Measure success, evidence support and steps under the same fixtures.
hints: When does model-led planning justify its cost?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Unbounded loops.

challenges.title: Agent evaluation and team patterns
challenges.description: Trajectory constraints, replay, role separation and handoff cost.
challenges.problem: Compare a two-role design to typed stages.
requirements: Unauthorized effects fail evaluation even when answers look correct.
hints: Can different trajectories be valid?
challenges.outcome: P2, Level 4. Study later: Agent swarms.

challenges.title: Tool calling and MCP primitives
challenges.description: Schema, typed execution, host/client/server, tools/resources/prompts and negotiation.
challenges.problem: Implement a read-only MCP inventory service and client.
requirements: Discovery succeeds and malformed calls cause no effects.
hints: Who executes a model's tool request?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 3. Study later: Writing a transport implementation.

challenges.title: MCP authorization and compatibility
challenges.description: Protocol pinning, transport trust, scopes, capability drift and availability.
challenges.problem: Scope read tools and simulate unavailable or incompatible service.
requirements: Wrong scope, timeout and schema change fail safely.
hints: Where does execution authority belong?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Organization-wide tool registry.

challenges.title: State, checkpoints and approval
challenges.description: Workflow vs chat memory, TTL, immutable intent, approval binding and final checks.
challenges.problem: Persist and resume an ERP approval flow.
requirements: Mutated, stale and revoked approvals fail safely.
hints: What if the approver changes roles before execution?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Unbounded memory.

challenges.title: Failure recovery and reconciliation
challenges.description: Unknown outcomes, idempotency, status probes, compensation and dead letters.
challenges.problem: Simulate timeout after a mock ERP commit.
requirements: Restart reconciles to one effective external operation.
hints: When must a human resolve ambiguity?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Exactly-once claims across independent systems.

challenges.title: Redis cache and rate limits
challenges.description: Strings, hashes, sorted sets, TTL, cache-aside, invalidation, stampedes and atomic quotas.
challenges.problem: Build scoped cache and load-test tenant limits.
requirements: Test stale entries, concurrent limits and cache outage.
hints: When is fail-open unacceptable?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Redis as source of truth.

challenges.title: RabbitMQ, outbox and workers
challenges.description: Exchanges, confirms, acks, prefetch, backpressure, retry budgets, DLQ and outbox.
challenges.problem: Kill workers before and after commit.
requirements: Deduplicate replay and recover incomplete jobs.
hints: How do consumer acks differ from publisher confirms?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Kafka without replay need.

challenges.title: Docker, CI and cloud staging
challenges.description: Layers, non-root images, signals, CI artifacts, IAM, network boundaries and health checks.
challenges.problem: Deploy API and workers from CI artifacts on one cloud.
requirements: Staging reproduces builds and handles backward-compatible migration.
hints: Why does graceful drain matter?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Multiple clouds and Kubernetes.

challenges.title: OpenTelemetry traces and metrics
challenges.description: Context propagation, redacted structured logs, histograms and cardinality.
challenges.problem: Trace an API request across a queue and model call.
requirements: Locate a bottleneck without private prompts in telemetry.
hints: Which metadata should never become a label?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Operating a telemetry platform.

challenges.title: Capacity, latency and cost
challenges.description: Traffic envelope, TTFT, p95, quotas, saturation, per-task cost and resource isolation.
challenges.problem: Model 10x load and run a noisy-neighbor test.
requirements: State workload, bottlenecks, error rates and per-tenant behavior.
hints: When should a tenant get dedicated capacity?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Sharding before evidence.

challenges.title: Timeouts, retries and circuit breakers
challenges.description: End-to-end deadlines, jitter, error categories, bulkheads, shedding and breaker state.
challenges.problem: Inject provider slowness and Redis failure.
requirements: Bound retries and backlog while keeping authoritative data consistent.
hints: How do retries amplify an incident?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Service mesh.

challenges.title: SLO, restore and rollback
challenges.description: SLIs, error budgets, RTO/RPO, canaries, database restore and incident ownership.
challenges.problem: Rehearse bad release, restore and measured recovery.
requirements: Publish restore timing and check post-restore deletion rules.
hints: Can healthy uptime hide an AI quality outage?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Multi-region failover before need.

challenges.title: Open weights, quantization and serving
challenges.description: License, templates, weight/KV precision, GPU memory, continuous batching and vLLM.
challenges.problem: Compare local settings or a managed and local model.
requirements: Report quality, TTFT, throughput and peak VRAM.
hints: Why can batching hurt first-token latency?
challenges.outcome: P2, Level 3. Study later: Multi-node serving.

challenges.title: Fine-tuning, LoRA and QLoRA
challenges.description: SFT datasets, leakage, masked labels, low-rank updates and quantized bases.
challenges.problem: Prepare licensed examples and train one adapter if compute permits; compare memory separately.
requirements: Compare held-out quality and count trainable parameters.
hints: When is current knowledge better served by RAG?
challenges.outcome: P2, Level 3. Study later: Pretraining or kernel development.

challenges.title: OCR, vision and multimodal retrieval
challenges.description: Image patch intuition, resolution, text/image embeddings, evidence regions and costs.
challenges.problem: Compare OCR and vision; add page/region retrieval for hard cases.
requirements: Measure field accuracy and page recall and preserve coordinates.
hints: When is text extraction enough?
challenges.outcome: P2, Level 3. Study later: Training vision backbones.

challenges.title: Media lifecycle and validation
challenges.description: MIME, pixel limits, review status, retention and deterministic verification.
challenges.problem: Validate invoices and handle bounded media uploads.
requirements: Reject invalid media and route uncertain totals to review.
hints: Which amounts can be verified deterministically?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 3. Study later: Streaming media systems.

challenges.title: System design and migrations
challenges.description: Modular boundaries, staged migrations, dual reads, dependency isolation and cost models.
challenges.problem: Design and review an embedding cutover with a rollback exercise.
requirements: Demonstrate cutover consistency and document scaling limits.
hints: What evidence would justify splitting API and worker further?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Microservices as default.

challenges.title: Architecture review and standards
challenges.description: ADRs, quality gates, budgets, owner assignment and operational feedback.
challenges.problem: Lead review, write two ADRs and run a game day.
requirements: Independent review, peer adoption and follow-up decision evidence.
hints: What new evidence would make you retire a standard?
challenges.outcome: P2, Level 5. Study later: Claiming seniority from a demo.

challenges.title: Mentoring and communication
challenges.description: Teach debugging, review trade-offs and communicate scope to stakeholders.
challenges.problem: Mentor a peer through a delivery problem and request feedback.
requirements: Peer independently applies the method and gives attributable feedback.
hints: How did you verify the person could repeat the reasoning?
challenges.outcome: P2, Level 5. Study later: Measuring mentoring by advice volume.

challenges.title: Python and SQL interviews
challenges.description: Complexity, streaming, joins, windows, query plans and cancellation.
challenges.problem: Run timed unfamiliar coding and SQL prompts.
requirements: Explain edge cases, complexity and measured plan changes.
hints: Why did this index help?
challenges.outcome: P0, Level 3. Study later: Competitive programming grind.

challenges.title: AI design and English communication
challenges.description: Evaluation, safety, SLOs, trade-offs, evidence and concise asynchronous updates.
challenges.problem: Record 90-second introduction, design review and incident story.
requirements: Two independent mocks and a focused retest.
hints: Which experiment would change your recommendation?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 4. Study later: Memorized architecture scripts.

challenges.title: Remote role analysis and portfolio
challenges.description: Role evidence, Bangladesh eligibility, UTC overlap, case studies and transparent claims.
challenges.problem: Tailor two applications and record three proof links per role.
requirements: Each target has eligibility source, next action and evidence.
hints: Which claim is strongest and how can a reviewer verify it?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 3. Study later: Certificate collection.

challenges.title: Remote application feedback loop
challenges.description: Pipeline stages, follow-up, written communication and feedback patterns.
challenges.problem: Log opportunities, mock feedback and a revision action.
requirements: Review pipeline after two weeks and update target roles from evidence.
hints: What distinguishes a repeated skills gap from poor role fit?
challenges.outcome: P1, Level 3. Study later: Automated bulk application.
